blurb.en: The small MPC. Twelve pads, sampler and sequencer, runs on batteries, fits in a bag properly.
blurb.fi: Pieni MPC. Kaksitoista padia, samplaus ja sekvensointi, kulkee paristoilla ja mahtuu oikeasti laukkuun.
blurb.sv: Den lilla MPC:n. Tolv pads, sampler och sekvensiator, går på batterier och får plats i väskan på riktigt.

pull.q: Immediate, fun and intuitive are the three words that spring to mind with this latest MPC.

quotes.t: The most affordable way to lay your hands on the MPC sampling and sequencing feature set.
Nothing rivals it for portability and instant rhythmic gratification.
The smaller display affects how fast and easy it is to use this machine, which undermines one of the traditional advantages of using an MPC.
quotes.s: Sound On Sound · the honest caveat
